# 698. Partition to K Equal Sum Subsets

## Solution 1 (time O(n*2^n), space O(2^n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def canPartitionKSubsets(self, nums, k):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :type k: int
        :rtype: bool
        """
        sum_nums = sum(nums)
        if sum_nums % k:
            return False
        per_sum = sum_nums // k
        nums.sort()
        if nums[-1] > per_sum:
            return False
        n = len(nums)
        dp = [False for _ in range(1 << n)]
        cur_sum = [0 for _ in range(1 << n)]
        dp[0] = True
        for i in range(1 << n):
            if not dp[i]:
                continue
            for j in range(n):
                if cur_sum[i] + nums[j] > per_sum:
                    break
                if (i >> j) & 1 == 0:
                    nxt = i | (1 << j)
                    if not dp[nxt]:
                        cur_sum[nxt] = (cur_sum[i] + nums[j]) % per_sum
                        dp[nxt] = True
        return dp[(1 << n) - 1]
```
